heading: Wave 9: Auth, routes and the mutation/transport pipeline

briefs.focus: Read the installed docs, not memory: node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/{after,redirect,unstable_rethrow,headers,connection}.md, 03-file-conventions/route.md (handler signature with `{ params: Promise<...> }`, Response.redirect(url, 303), whether `export const GET = factory(...)` is accepted), 01-directives/use-cache.md ('use cache: private' and the ban on after()/headers inside it), and 02-guides/redirecting.md plus authentication-with-cache-components.md. Confirm where after() may be called (route handlers, Server Components, not in 'use cache'), and that redirect() throws NEXT_REDIRECT, which tests see as 'NEXT_REDIRECT <url>'. In node_modules/react, confirm that React 19.2.8 cache() memoizes only inside a Server Component render and not in route handlers (P176 note 4). Also confirm that Flight rejects a function child passed to a 'use client' component (the P255 prototype-key crash). Read these repo files first: src/app/api/mutation-route.ts, src/app/api/capability-route.ts, src/composition/session.ts, src/composition/route-guards.ts, src/app/api/auth/[...all]/route.ts, src/app/(site)/admin/load-section.ts, src/app/(site)/atlas/AtlasBound.tsx, src/app/api/market-refresh-route.ts.

- auth.api.getSession with the customSession plugin: the return shape, and whether customSession re-runs on a cookie-cache hit.
- auth.api.unlinkAccount: its arguments, and FAILED_TO_UNLINK_LAST_ACCOUNT in dist/api/routes/account.mjs (~243).
- The P161 security premise, to re-confirm: findOAuthUser's fallback lookup by email (dist/db/internal-adapter.mjs ~429-475), handleOAuthUserInfo's implicit linking, and overrideUserInfo (dist/oauth2/link-account.mjs 9-76). Note the exact accountLinking option names, for example disableImplicitLinking and allowDifferentEmails.
- The genericOAuth config: clientId/clientSecret are read at load time.
- The client authClient.signIn.oauth2 and authClient.oauth2.link: their return types, and whether a network failure rejects (better-fetch 1.3.1 without catchAllError).
Read these repo files first: src/platform/auth/auth.ts, src/composition/auth.ts, src/platform/auth/auth-client.ts, src/platform/auth/link-character.ts, src/platform/auth/session-identity.ts, src/platform/auth/account-purge.ts, src/app/api/account/characters/unlink/route.ts.

waveCautions:
No Convex changes and no codegen. The admin and account form routes are one hotspot chain: land P251, P141, P146, P255, P256, P250 and P161 in that order, each changing only its own layer. The README conflict resolutions override the item write-ups:
- P251's parseFormBody(request, schema, fields), with 'invalid_form' and `Invalid <field>`, replaces P146's formData guard, formFields and per-route detail strings.
- Only P146 defines seeOther(request, path, {query, failure}).
- The auth_error tuple lives in platform/auth/api-contract.ts.
- P222 drops signInWithEve. P067 (wave 8, done) added startEveSignIn in link-character.ts, migrated the sign-in call sites, and already switched startCharacterLink to EVE_PROVIDER_ID from @/lib/eve-provider; P222 still adds the catch to startCharacterLink.

Merge the switch and unlink form schemas once, in P146 or P306, not both. P167 rewrites the preview page before P254 does. P256 already performs P161's single roster read for admin unlink. Add seeOther and apiFailure to PROTECTED_RESPONSE_EXPORTS. After P141, P250 must also pass `endpoint` for account/delete and feedback. Some sites drifted: the superadmin parses moved to AccessCards.tsx and UserDetailCards.tsx, and the statics copy to statics-view.ts. P251, P141 and P255 change status codes. P176 and P161 are medium risk: land P176's throttle before the guard switch, and P161, a security fix, needs DB regressions. Notes left by earlier waves: P138 sees AccountDangerZone importing HelpPopover from ui/help-popover (P007), not Popover, and using the shared useConfirmGate from ui/use-confirm-gate (P056). For items that add, remove or rename routes or pages, run `node scripts/assert-routes-present.mjs` before committing: GitHub's Verify job (which also checks routes) runs only on manual dispatch, not on PRs. Notes from wave 8: P005 moved the one-button account and admin forms (switch character, unlink, role toggle, admin unlink, force logout, reassign, dead-letter retry, statics) onto ui ActionForm and ConfirmActionForm; form contract tests read each form's action and hidden fields through src/lib/__tests__/posted-forms.ts, and ui-adoption.test.ts pins zero hand-built POST forms, hidden inputs and disabled-control titles outside ui. P012 moved the linked-character health label to deriveLinkedCharacterStatus in platform/auth/scope-health.ts and deleted settings/characters/characters-view.ts; deriveCharacterHealth and listGrantedScopes are now private. P062 moved admin/status-tone.ts to components/status-level-tone.ts. P067 added signOutAndLeave(target) in platform/auth/reload-document-home.ts (AccountDangerZone's log-out-everywhere uses it) and folded forgetSignedInBrowser into reloadDocumentHome. P271 made buildBreadcrumbList take { name, path } crumbs and add Home itself, and buildPageMetadata gained socialImage.
